name: get_status
description: Get the status of unreleased fragments and the next computed version.

name: create_fragment
description: Create a new unreleased change fragment.

category.description: The category of the change (e.g., Added, Fixed, Changed, Removed).

apiMinLevel.description: Optional minimum API impact level (patch, minor, major). Fails if fragments are below this level.

name: perform_release
description: Perform a release by aggregating fragments and bumping versions.

dryRun.description: If true, only preview the changes without applying them.

allowMajor.description: Allow a release whose impact exceeds SemverPolicy.MaxImpact.

apiMinLevel.description: Optional minimum API impact level (patch, minor, major). Fails if fragments are below this level.
